invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new list using Collectors.toList(), which is never null.
Each element in result corresponds to a unique key after grouping; the number of unique keys cannot exceed the size of the input.
Parallelism is intended to control parallel stream behavior and should always be a positive integer.
The input data list is always used (e.g., data.stream()), indicating it should not be null.
Both functions are invoked (wrapped and passed to stream operations), so they must be non-null.
